name: Image Agent
description: AI agent that handles image processing, analysis, and generation for LinkedIn posts

parameters.prompt: ={{ $json.imageDescription || 'Professional LinkedIn post image with modern flat-style, consistent with a business content theme.' }}

parameters.functionCode: const existing = $input.first().json; const generated = $input.second().json; return { includeInPost: true, imageUrl: existing.imageUrl || generated.imageUrl, imageAnalysis: existing.imageAnalysis || generated.imageAnalysis, recommendations: (existing.recommendations||[]).concat(generated.recommendations||[]), chatId: existing.chatId || generated.chatId };
